metaTitle: WeChat Pay for Foreigners (2026): Card, TenPayGo or PayPal
metaDescription: Pay at WeChat Pay shops in China three ways: WeChat with a foreign card, Tencent's TenPayGo (I tested it) or PayPal for US users. Fees and limits.
heading: WeChat Pay for Foreigners: Setup and Payment Guide (2026)

byline.name: Maintained by Lin
byline.tested: Checked against official sources, October 31, 2026. TenPayGo payment tested in Dongguan, October 25, 2026

quickAnswer: Yes. As a visitor you can pay at shops that take WeChat Pay in three ways:

items: **WeChat with a foreign card.** Sign up for WeChat with your own non-Chinese phone number and link a Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club or UnionPay card. Verify your passport to raise your limit to up to US$5,000 a payment.
**TenPayGo.** Tencent's payment app for visitors pays at the same shops without a WeChat account. I signed up with just an email, linked a UK Mastercard and paid at a shop in Dongguan.
**PayPal, for US accounts.** Since August 11, 2026, US PayPal users can scan a shop's WeChat Pay code in the PayPal app.

quickAnswer: **Fees with a foreign card:** no fee on payments of ¥200 or less throughout 2026. The first time you link a card, you also pay no fee on up to ¥1,000 a day for 90 days (offer until December 31, 2026). Otherwise, a 3% fee may apply to the whole amount over ¥200.

blocks.text: **My advice:** if WeChat lets you sign up, link your card there, because you can then also order and pay in mini programs. If it won't verify you, TenPayGo pays at the same shops with just an email. Either way, set up Alipay as well: [Alipay for foreigners](/alipay-for-foreigners/).
Most shops I go to take both WeChat Pay and Alipay.

sections.title: Set up WeChat Pay with a foreign card

items: Install or update **WeChat** and sign up with your own phone number. Tencent's guide says any country code other than +86 works for linking a foreign card.
If WeChat asks an existing user to verify your new account and you don't know anyone, see [WeChat verification without a friend's QR code](/wechat-verification-without-friend-qr-2026/).
Open **Me**, then **Services** and **Wallet**, and add your card with its basic details. Menu names can differ slightly between versions.
Approve any check your bank sends to its app, and set the 6-digit payment PIN when WeChat asks.
To raise your limit, verify your identity with your passport. Tencent says this can take seconds.

blocks.text: Do it at home before you fly, so any checks from your bank are sorted out before you need to pay. Turn on overseas and online payments in your banking app so your first payment in China isn't blocked.

sections.title: Fees and limits with a foreign card

items: **¥200 or less:** no 3% fee, for all foreign cards, throughout 2026 (WeChat Pay, May 2026).
**The first card you link:** no 3% fee on up to ¥1,000 a day for 90 days after your first payment. The offer runs until December 31, 2026.
**Otherwise, over ¥200:** a 3% fee may apply to the whole amount (Shanghai government, September 2026). On a ¥300 dinner, that's ¥9.
**Your bank** may add its own foreign transaction or currency conversion fee.

blocks.text: The fee line shows on the confirmation screen before you tap **Pay**, so check it on bigger payments.
China raised these limits in March 2024, from US$1,000 a payment and US$10,000 a year.

TenPayGo is Tencent's own payment app for visitors, launched on September 24, 2026. It isn't WeChat: it's a separate app that pays at shops that take WeChat Pay. You don't need a WeChat account or a Chinese phone number.

items: **Sign-up:** an email address and the code it sends. It didn't ask for a phone number, passport or face scan.
**Card:** I linked a UK Mastercard. My bank asked me to approve a ¥0.00 check.
**Paying:** I paid ¥4.90 at a shop in Dongguan by showing my payment code. The ¥0.15 card fee (3%) was crossed out.

blocks.text: The full test, including the Shenzhen metro: [TenPayGo review](/tenpaygo-for-tourists/).

sections.title: US PayPal users: pay in the PayPal app

blocks.text: Since August 11, 2026, PayPal says US PayPal users can pay at Weixin Pay merchants across China:

items: Open the PayPal app and scan the shop's WeChat Pay QR code, or show the QR code in the PayPal app for the cashier to scan.
You don't need another app, a local wallet or a Chinese bank account.
PayPal suggests updating the app first, keeping money in your PayPal balance (Auto Reload is optional) and turning on location services.

blocks.text: So far it's for US accounts only. PayPal's announcement doesn't mention fees or the exchange rate, so check the amount before you confirm. I don't have a US PayPal account, so I haven't tested it.

sections.title: How to pay at a shop

blocks.text: Whichever app you use, there are two ways to pay:

items: **The shop scans your code:** open your payment code and hold it up to the scanner.
**You scan the shop's code:** scan the QR code on the counter, type the amount, check the shop name and pay.

blocks.text: Bigger shops scan my code with a scanner at the checkout. A lot of small shops just stick a printed QR code on the counter for me to scan: it costs them almost nothing and it's convenient.

**In restaurants,** the QR code on the table usually opens a mini program, an ordering page inside WeChat or Alipay, where you order and pay. TenPayGo and PayPal are for paying, and I haven't tried ordering with them. If the code won't open, ask staff to take your order. More: [how to order food in China](/china-food-ordering-guide/).
Ordering by scanning the code on the table almost always opens a mini program.
Never send a photo of your payment code to anyone: whoever scans it can take a payment.

faqs.question: Can foreigners use WeChat Pay in China?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can link a supported foreign card in WeChat, use Tencent's TenPayGo app, or, with a US PayPal account, pay in the PayPal app. All three pay at shops that take WeChat Pay.

faqs.question: Can US citizens use WeChat Pay in China?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover are among the supported networks, in WeChat or TenPayGo. Since August 2026, US PayPal users can also pay WeChat Pay codes in the PayPal app. Your bank can still decline a payment.

faqs.question: Does WeChat Pay charge fees for foreign cards?
faqs.answer: Payments of ¥200 or less have no fee throughout 2026. The first time you link a card, you pay no fee on up to ¥1,000 a day for 90 days (offer until December 31, 2026). Otherwise a 3% fee may apply to the whole amount over ¥200, and your bank may add its own fee.

faqs.question: What is the WeChat Pay limit for foreigners?
faqs.answer: With passport verification, up to US$5,000 a payment and US$50,000 a year. Unverified accounts have a lower limit, which Tencent doesn't publish.

faqs.question: Do I need a Chinese bank account for WeChat Pay?
faqs.answer: No. You pay with a foreign card. Tencent's guide says to sign up with a non-Chinese phone number, and TenPayGo only needs an email.

faqs.question: Can I use WeChat Pay without a WeChat account?
faqs.answer: Yes. TenPayGo, Tencent's app for visitors, pays at the same shops and signs you up with an email. US PayPal users can pay in the PayPal app.

faqs.question: Is Weixin Pay the same as WeChat Pay for foreign visitors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Weixin Pay is the official name of the payment service in mainland China; Tencent and the TenPayGo app use it. WeChat Pay HK is a separate Hong Kong wallet with its own rules.

faqs.question: Can I set up WeChat Pay before arriving in China?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it's easier at home: sign up, link your card and verify your passport while you can still approve your bank's checks.

faqs.question: What should I do if WeChat Pay is declined?
faqs.answer: Approve any blocked attempt in your banking app and check whether you've reached the limit for unverified accounts. Then pay with Alipay, another card or cash, and check the payment record before trying again.

faqs.question: Should I choose WeChat Pay or Alipay for China?
faqs.answer: Set up both if you can. In my experience most shops take both, so one is your backup. Restaurant table ordering usually opens a mini program inside WeChat or Alipay.
